value.answer: Depends if the mortgage is insured (under 20% down) or not. Insured: the lowest 5-year fixed I found is 4.34%, which Ratehub has as of today and WOWA had as of Oct 9. Uninsured: the lowest is 4.44% at WOWA. Big banks average about 5.14%, and rates are climbing this month.
